subsystems.name: Optical engine
subsystems.role: creates the image that is projected into the waveguide.
parts: microdisplay (microLED, LCOS or laser beam scanning)

subsystems.name: Waveguide combiner
subsystems.role: transparent display that guides light to the eye while letting the real world through.

subsystems.name: Sensing and input
subsystems.role: captures the environment and user commands.

subsystems.name: Compute and AI
subsystems.role: runs vision, translation and rendering locally, often with a phone or cloud assist.

subsystems.name: Power and thermal
subsystems.role: supplies energy within tight weight and heat limits.

subsystems.name: Frame and ergonomics
subsystems.role: houses everything in a wearable, glasses-like form.

buildSteps.title: Design the optical stack
buildSteps.detail: Simulate waveguide efficiency, field of view, eye box and colour uniformity, then choose a microdisplay to match.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the waveguide
buildSteps.detail: Pattern nanoscale diffraction gratings onto a glass or high-index plastic wafer using etching or nanoimprint lithography.

buildSteps.title: Make the microdisplay
buildSteps.detail: Fabricate a microLED array or LCOS panel on silicon in a semiconductor fab, then test pixel yield and brightness.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the optical module
buildSteps.detail: Align the display to the waveguide with micrometre precision, cure the adhesive, and measure brightness and ghosting.

buildSteps.title: Integrate electronics
buildSteps.detail: Place the NPU, sensors, battery and antennas into the temples, connecting them with flexible printed circuits.

buildSteps.title: Build the frame
buildSteps.detail: Injection-mould or 3D-print the frame, then fit the optical module, electronics and prescription inserts.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and test
buildSteps.detail: Align the virtual image, calibrate eye tracking and camera, and run translation, AI and battery-life tests.

buildSteps.title: Deploy software and AI
buildSteps.detail: Train or fine-tune translation and vision models, optimise them for on-device inference, and push updates over the air.

prerequisites.why: LCOS is mature, but high-brightness, full-colour microLED for glasses is still emerging.
efficient, full-colour waveguides at consumer cost and scale remain hard to manufacture.
NPUs exist, but running real-time translation and vision within glasses' power and heat limits is difficult.
neural translation models are mature enough for real-time text and speech.
energy density limits all-day use, and heat must be dissipated from a small, wearable frame.

pathway.milestone: audio-only AI glasses with camera and voice assistant, plus early monocular display glasses with basic translation
pathway.unlocks: hands-free capture, translation and notifications without looking at a phone.

pathway.milestone: full-colour, wider field-of-view displays with real-time translation and AI information overlay
pathway.unlocks: useful augmented reality for travel, navigation and work.

pathway.milestone: prescription-ready glasses with all-day battery and seamless phone integration
pathway.unlocks: everyday wear without compromise, moving the category beyond early adopters.

pathway.milestone: lightweight, stylish AR glasses that can replace a phone screen
pathway.unlocks: a new computing platform where digital information is blended with the physical world.
